name: Front-end with Vue
summary: The one you can adopt a page at a time: the gentlest curve of the four, with a full-stack answer of its own in Nuxt.
prerequisites: Both are required. It is the easiest of the four to start with, and the only one that adopts an existing page a piece at a time.
syllabus: Single-file components and the Composition API
Reactivity: ref, reactive, computed and the traps
Nuxt: routing by file, rendering modes and data fetching
TypeScript in Vue, and where it costs something
